content.title: Labubu, Opendoor, Airbnb, Nvidia: What's trending in markets
content.description:
Shares of Pop Mart (9992.HK), the Chinese toy maker behind the Labubu dolls, are down sharply after an exchange between employees commenting on the toys' price goes viral. Opendoor (OPEN) stock nosedives after the new CEO presents his turnaround strategy. Airbnb (ABNB) rallies as Goldman Sachs (GS) raises its price target for the stock. UK's ITV (ITV.L) soars on hopes of a potential deal with Comcast (CMCSA)'s Sky. As AI chip stocks including Nvidia (NVDA) and AMD slide, Qualcomm (QCOM)'s CEO strikes an optimistic note.

For more live coverage of the markets, watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and visit Yahoo Finance.

content.title: Opendoor Gets Slammed as Loss Widens—Heard on the Street
content.summary: Opendoor Technologies, which became a high-flying meme stock earlier this year, is down sharply Friday after reporting disappointing quarterly results.  The company was the subject of an Oct. 3 Heard on the Street column that flagged a crucial problem for its business model: The economics of the home-flipping business don’t scale.  Buying and selling homes for resale is both labor- and capital-intensive.

content.title: Opendoor Stock Dives After Earnings. Why New Leadership Faces Short-Term Pain.
content.summary: Opendoor Technologies  stock fell Friday after the online homebuying platform’s first earnings report under new leadership.  Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, or Ebitda, came in at a negative $33 million, worse than analysts’ forecast of a $24.4 Ebitda loss.  Opendoor stock fell 7.8% to $6.05 Friday.
